The source and unmodified hex carriers come from Edict's public JSONL application
build, using compiler 3df3a6437f7999206b12b4dd6b5400db7a612fd8 and the retained
legacy provider package used by the byte-literal public proof. The source

The accepted verifier report binds package identity
`75381ef9f3421a74f2fa21e256705e9737b94eda1f7549b5b23c254799254086`.
